messages.subject: Whitmore — Board settlement authority sought
messages.plaintextBody:
Chair, Iqbal, Lorna,

Ahead of the Board meeting, a short summary: Whitfield Carter assess our defence prospects on the whistleblowing claim at 40–45%, exposure uncapped and potentially c.£206k on the claimant's figures. They recommend settling. I'll ask the Board to authorise a ceiling of £185,000 inclusive plus up to £5,000 towards the claimant's legal fees, no admission of liability.

Daniel

messages.subject: RE: Whitmore — Board settlement authority sought
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel — I support settling given the regulatory backdrop and the uncapped risk. Let's take the formal resolution at the April board once terms are close, but you have my in-principle agreement to open negotiations within that ceiling.

Helena Marsh
Chair
